newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bond gains seen in pipeline after base.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bond gains seen in pipeline after base.

text.p: Signs of a base formation in T-bond futures may be conducive to some gains on Friday, but the upside is heavily congested, technical analysts said.
A blip up early on through the initial barrier of 109-12 has suddenly improved the market's short-term prospects, but analysts are looking for the medium-term bearish tone to remain.

Sam Malone-Jansens at Lloyd's Bank Futures in London said candlestick charts were showing a tweezer bottom and a regular tower bottom, both formed this week. A rally to 109-23, the low on May 19, and from there to 110-00 was now likely.
At 1042 GMT, June T-bonds stood 4/32 higher at 109-14.
Malone-Jansens said the tweezer bottom was formed at 108-17 and 108-18, the lows on Tuesday and Wednesday respectively.

Tuesday's and Thursday's closes however pointed to a regular tower bottom. This involved a lower close on Tuesday after an initial climb and a higher close on Thursday after a dip -- a "black day" and an "up day" in candlestick terms.
"Additionally, nine-day slow stochastics have broken to the upside now. They are trading around 31.5 pct after having tested two-month lows at 16 pct," Malone-Jansens said.
He concluded that the short term outlook was mildly bullish, although a down trend from December highs was still intact.

If T-bonds could get though the initial congestion at 109-23 and 110-00, they could head up to tackle resistance at 110-12 and 110-22, Malone-Jansens said. He pegged support at congestion levels of 109-06 and 109-01, and 108-28 on hourly charts.
On the LIFFE floor, a trader at a British bank also saw a positive chart outlook after Thursday's strong close.

"The pivot point at 108-27 yesterday held well and has moved up to 109-04 today. As long as that holds things look very good," he said. The outlook remained optimistic while the T-bond yield stayed below seven pct, he added. By 1035 GMT, the three-month Eurodollar future was up by 0.005 at 93.955.
